Description: Infection of susceptible humans through bites by infectious mosquitoes.
Progression of exposed humans to the symptomatic infectious state.
Progression of exposed humans to the asymptomatic infectious state.
Reinfection of asymptomatic individuals by infectious mosquitoes, causing them to become symptomatic.
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes by biting symptomatic or asymptomatic infectious humans.

Name: B
Description: The constant influx rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_h
Description: The natural death rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_v
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.

Name: γ_1(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts. The numerical example uses a constant value.

Name: γ_2(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts. The numerical example uses a constant value.

Name: β_v(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes. The numerical example uses a constant value.

Name: β_h(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts. The numerical example uses a constant value.

Name: ρ
Description: The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: σ
Description: The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
